description: Open, content-addressed refund references over the AlgoVoi substrate (RFC 8785 JCS + SHA-256). refund_ref = "sha256:" + SHA-256(JCS({refund_amount, refund_result, subject_ref})). The subject_ref is the prior payment/decision being refunded, imported by hash: rf-001/002/003 refund subject sha256:2a444c62... which is the ALLOW guardrail_ref in spend_guardrail_lite_v1 / spend_decision_chain_v1, so the refund composes onto the live decision chain (it closes the lifecycle after the authorized payment). refund_result is a closed enum {FULL, PARTIAL, REJECTED}; a result outside the enum, or an empty subject_ref or refund_amount, is rejected, not hashed. All three fields are byte-load-bearing. Lite tier: no signature; the commercial Refund Receipt adds Falcon-1024 PQC signing, provider + timing + jurisdiction, and closes the original payment across the settlement and retention chains.
note_chain: subject_ref sha256:2a444c62... is the ALLOW guardrail_ref in spend_guardrail_lite_v1 / spend_decision_chain_v1; refund_ref binds a categorical result + amount to that exact authorized payment, closing the lifecycle after settlement.

negatives.note: same subject + amount, different result; refund_ref diverges
the refund amount is byte-load-bearing; 1000 -> 2000 diverges the ref
same result + amount, different subject; a refund cannot be re-pointed to another payment

negatives.reason: refund_result must be one of the closed enum; an unknown result is rejected, not hashed
subject_ref must be a non-empty string; an empty field is rejected, not hashed

invariants.assert: changing any of {refund_amount, refund_result, subject_ref} changes refund_ref (rf-001, result-swap, amount-tamper, subject-swap all distinct)
a result outside the closed enum, an empty subject_ref, and an empty refund_amount are all rejected
